fields.name: domain
fields.description:
Get a single domain by name or namehash. Exact get: returns the row even if
  non-normalized (unlike domains/where.name, which default-hide non-normalized
  names); unreachable rows are still hidden (returns null). `atBlock` (ensv2
  extension) reconstructs the domain's state as of that block from the event
  log — V2 names only; scalar fields, `resolver { addr text(key:) contentHash }`
  and `resolvedAddress` are historical; list record fields return empty at-block;
  nested domain entities (parent/subdomains) reflect current state; an
  out-of-range block or a name without V2 event history resolves to null.

fields.name: roles
fields.description: Get EAC role assignments. Filters combine; `contract` scopes shared resource values (ROOT, 0x0, exists on every EAC-enabled contract) to one registry/resolver. `protocol` selects v1/v2 (default v2). `resource` matches the value exactly as emitted (registry: `canonical_id | eacVersionId`; any hex spelling accepted). Without `resource`, rows superseded by a higher EAC version of the same label on the same contract (a later registration of that label) are omitted; name a resource explicitly to see a superseded generation. A label that was unregistered or expired without being re-registered keeps its last generation listed — read the label's own state for that.

  subgraph-style entity listing.

fields.name: resolvers
fields.description:
List Resolver entities (subgraph parity). One entity per (protocol, address,
  namehash) binding. Entity `id` is rendered `{protocol}-{address}-{namehash}`
  (using `v1`/`v2` as the isolation prefix since both protocols share the chain).

fields.name: _finality
fields.description:
Finality signalling (ensv2 extension, NOT subgraph). Per-chain head / safe /
  finalized block positions so a consumer can judge how settled an answer is.
  `safe`/`finalized` are null until FINALITY_ENABLED and the indexer has fetched them.

fields.name: _coverage
fields.description:
What this deployment indexes (ensv2 extension): chain id, per-protocol indexed
  head + last-sync time, and a staleness flag. `stale` is false when finality data
  is absent (default deployments); `_finality.isStale` is the conservative variant.

types.name: Domain
types.description: An ENS domain name

fields.name: id
fields.description: Domain namehash (ERC-137 node hash), matching the ENS subgraph. The singular `domain(id:)` lookup still accepts a name or a namehash.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full domain name (e.g., 'vitalik.eth')

fields.name: labelName
fields.description: Label only (e.g., 'vitalik' for 'vitalik.eth')

fields.name: labelhash
fields.description: Keccak256 hash of the label. Non-null: this indexer only materializes a Domain once its label is known (it never creates tokenId-only rows like the subgraph/ENSNode), so clients need no null guard.

fields.name: parent
fields.description: Parent domain

fields.name: subdomains
fields.description: Subdomains of this domain

fields.name: resolvedAddress
fields.description: Address this domain resolves to

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Current owner of the domain

fields.name: resolver
fields.description: Resolver contract for this domain

fields.name: subregistry
fields.description: The registry contract that manages this domain's subnames — the value of the parent registry's `getSubregistry(label)` pointer, set from `SubregistryUpdated`. Null when no subregistry is set (or for V1 names). This is the registry whose `referencedBy` includes this domain.

fields.name: ttl
fields.description: ENS V1 Registry TTL (from `NewTTL` event). Null when never set or for V2 domains.

fields.name: isLegacy
fields.description: V1-only provenance: true when the row's most recent update came from the legacy pre-2020 ENS Registry (0x314159…); false when it's been touched by the canonical post-2020 Registry (0x00…2e1e) or for V2 names.

fields.name: isMigrated
fields.description: Whether this domain has been migrated to V2

fields.name: isWrapped
fields.description: Whether this name is currently wrapped in V1 NameWrapper. When true, the `owner` field returns the wrapped-token owner (EOA), NOT the NameWrapper contract address — this is a deliberate divergence from the ENS subgraph for client convenience. Subgraph clients that need the NameWrapper-as-owner shape should query the on-chain `ownerOf()` directly.

fields.name: fuses
fields.description: Fuse bitmap from V1 NameWrapper (CANNOT_UNWRAP, PARENT_CANNOT_CONTROL, etc.). Null when not wrapped.

fields.name: wrapperExpiry
fields.description: Wrapper expiry timestamp from V1 NameWrapper. Null when not wrapped.

fields.name: gracePeriodEnd
fields.description: Grace-period end for V1 .eth 2LDs (expiry + 90 days). Now an explicit-name alias for `Domain.expiryDate` (which itself includes the grace period for V1 .eth 2LDs per subgraph parity). Null for non-V1 names, non-.eth 2LDs, or names without expiry.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: ENS protocol version this domain belongs to ("v1" = legacy ENS, "v2" = ENSv2).

fields.name: isReachable
fields.description:
Whether this domain is reachable via canonical top-down resolution.
  False when an ancestor label's subregistry pointer has moved away from
  the subregistry contract that originally minted this domain (orphaned
  subtree), when the domain has been LabelUnregistered, or when an
  ancestor expiry has passed. Default GraphQL queries filter
  `isReachable: true` — pass `where: { includeUnreachable: true }` to
  include orphans.

fields.name: unreachableSince
fields.description: Timestamp when this domain first became unreachable (null while reachable)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when domain was created

fields.name: registrationDate
fields.description: Timestamp when domain was registered

fields.name: registrant
fields.description: Original registrant of the domain

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Timestamp when domain expires. For V1 .eth 2LDs, includes the 90-day grace period (`BaseRegistrar.expires + 90d`) to match subgraph semantics. The bare on-chain `expires` is still available via the parallel `Registration.expiryDate`.

fields.name: tokenId
fields.description: ERC-721 token ID for this domain

fields.name: canonicalId
fields.description: Canonical token ID (without version bits)

fields.name: tokenVersion
fields.description: Token version number

fields.name: normalizedName
fields.description: ENSIP-15 normalized name (null if normalization fails)

fields.name: isNormalized
fields.description: Whether the name passes ENSIP-15 normalization (computed at query time)

fields.name: finality
fields.description: Finality tier of this domain's CURRENT state — how settled it is against chain finality. FINALIZED = the last change is at/below the finalized head (will not reorg); SAFE = at/below the safe head; HEAD = in the unsafe zone (may still reorg). Null when finality tracking is disabled (FINALITY_ENABLED off), so a client can distinguish 'unknown' from 'unsafe'.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Events associated with this domain

fields.name: subdomainsCount
fields.description: Count of direct subdomains (one level only). Filtered by `isReachable = 1` AND excluding fully-burned names (owner=0 AND resolver=0, mirroring subgraph's GC deletion criteria). DEPRECATED: prefer `subdomainCount` (subgraph-compatible name).

fields.name: subdomainCount
fields.description: Subgraph-compatible alias for `subdomainsCount`. Returns the same value.

fields.name: eventsCount
fields.description: Count of events associated with this domain

fields.name: roleHolderCount
fields.description:
Number of distinct accounts holding any label-scoped role on this label,
  matched by the label's canonical (version-independent) token id and its
  registry. Excludes the registry-wide root/admin role and empty role bitmaps,
  so it reflects only roles tied to this individual label.

fields.name: wrappedDomain
fields.description: V1 NameWrapper wrapped-domain record. Null for V2 or unwrapped domains.

fields.name: wrappedOwner
fields.description: Wrapped owner (V1 NameWrapper EOA). Null when not wrapped.

types.name: Account
types.description: An Ethereum account (address)

fields.name: id
fields.description: Ethereum address

fields.name: domains
fields.description: Domains owned by this account

fields.name: registrations
fields.description: Registrations made by this account

fields.name: primaryName
fields.description: Reverse-resolved primary name for this address (V1 ReverseRegistrar + NameChanged path). Null if not claimed.

fields.name: primaryNameVerification
fields.description: ENSIP-3 forward verification of `primaryName` (Task 05). Additive — does NOT alter `primaryName`. VERIFIED = the name's forward resolution (via the Universal Resolver when configured) points back to this address; MISMATCH = it resolves to a different address; INVALID_NAME = the claimed name is not ENSIP-15 normalized; NOT_FOUND = no resolver/record; UNVERIFIED = the on-chain read reverted / errored / not checked. Null unless PRIMARY_VERIFY_ENABLED, and computed only for single-entity lookups (never per-row in a list).

fields.name: wrappedDomains
fields.description: V1 NameWrapper wrapped-domain records owned by this account.

fields.name: seenV1
fields.description: True if this address has ever been observed acting under the V1 protocol (owner, registrant, role grantee, transfer recipient, or operator).

fields.name: seenV2
fields.description: True if this address has ever been observed acting under the V2 protocol.

fields.name: firstSeenBlock
fields.description: Block number of the earliest observation across protocols. Zero if the account row was populated by backfill (no first-observation block was recorded).

fields.name: firstSeenTimestamp
fields.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the earliest observation across protocols. Zero if unknown.

enumValues.name: firstSeenBlock

types.name: ResolverFilter
types.description:
Filter input for the `resolvers` (entity-list) query (subgraph parity).
Fields combine with AND semantics. Use `address`/`address_in` to scope by
resolver contract, `namehash` to scope by name, and `protocol` (`"v1"` or
`"v2"`) for protocol isolation.

inputFields.name: address
inputFields.description: Exact match on resolver contract address (0x-hex, lowercase).

inputFields.name: address_in
inputFields.description: Resolver contract address in list (up to 1000).

inputFields.name: namehash
inputFields.description: Exact match on the bound name's namehash.

inputFields.name: protocol
inputFields.description: Restrict to a single protocol — `"v1"` or `"v2"`.

types.name: Resolver_orderBy
types.description: Sort key for the `resolvers` (entity-list) query.

enumValues.name: address
enumValues.description: Lexicographic order on the resolver contract address.

enumValues.name: setBlock
enumValues.description: First-binding block (when this resolver was first bound to this name).

types.name: CoinAddress
types.description: A coin address record with coin type (SLIP-44)

fields.description: SLIP-44 coin type (e.g., 60 for ETH, 0 for BTC, 501 for SOL). DEPRECATED: prefer `coinTypeBig` — ENSIP-11 L2 coin types (0x80000000 | chainId) exceed Int32 and will overflow. Kept for back-compat.

fields.name: coinTypeBig
fields.description: Decimal-string coin type. Use this instead of `coinType` to safely represent ENSIP-11 L2 coin types that exceed Int32.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Address value for this coin type

types.name: Pubkey
types.description: A public key record (secp256k1 coordinates)

fields.name: x
fields.description: X coordinate (hex string)

fields.name: y
fields.description: Y coordinate (hex string)

types.name: InterfaceRecord
types.description: An interface implementation record

fields.name: interfaceId
fields.description: Interface ID (EIP-165 selector, hex string)

fields.name: implementer
fields.description: Implementer contract address

types.name: LinkedName
types.description: A name bound to a record on a record-model resolver (contracts-v2 IRecordResolver). Record sharing replaces aliasing: every name linked to the same record serves the same values.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The bound name (empty for the resolver-wide default record bound to node 0x0)

fields.name: namehash
fields.description: The bound node (namehash)

fields.name: recordId
fields.description: The record id (decimal string; a full uint256 — SharedResolver keys records by the name's node itself)

types.name: Alias
types.description: A resolver alias mapping (from OwnedResolver)

fields.name: fromName
fields.description: Source DNS name

fields.name: toName
fields.description: Destination DNS name

types.name: Resolver
types.description: A resolver contract for an ENS domain

fields.name: id
fields.description: Resolver contract address

fields.name: address
fields.description: Resolver contract address (same as id)

fields.name: addr
fields.description: Address record for a specific coin type (default: 60 for ETH)

fields.name: addresses
fields.description: All set addresses across all coin types

fields.name: coinTypes
fields.description: All coin types currently set on this resolver/name as decimal strings (ENSIP-11-safe). Parallel projection of `addresses.coinTypeBig`.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Canonical Domain associated with this resolver (first by namehash). Null when this resolver isn't bound to any name. Subgraph parity.

fields.name: contentHash
fields.description: Content hash (IPFS, Arweave, etc.)

fields.name: texts
fields.description:
All text-record keys set on this resolver/name. This is a list of scalar
  strings (the keys only), NOT a list of {key, value} entities — the ENS
  subgraph's `texts` field has the same name but a different shape, so a
  subgraph-style `texts { key value }` selection will fail. To read values,
  call `text(key: "...")` per key.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Get a specific text record value by key (returns null if unset).

fields.name: pubkey
fields.description: Public key record (secp256k1 x/y coordinates)

fields.name: abis
fields.description:
ABI content types set on this resolver. List of scalar integers (the
  contentType bitmasks only), not a list of entities — `abis { ... }` with
  a subselection will fail.

fields.name: reverseName
fields.description: Reverse name record (from NameChanged events)

fields.name: interfaces
fields.description: Interface implementations set on this resolver

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Aliases set on this resolver (from AliasChanged events)

fields.name: version
fields.description: Current version counter (from VersionChanged events)

fields.name: recordId
fields.description: Record-model resolvers (contracts-v2 IRecordResolver) key values by record, not node: the record this name resolves through — its own record, else the resolver's default record (node 0x0). Decimal string; null on legacy node-keyed resolvers or when the name is unlinked and there is no default.

fields.name: recordModel
fields.description: True when the resolver announced itself as record-model (ResolverCreated).

fields.name: linkedNames
fields.description: Every name bound to the same record as this name (record sharing replaces aliasing). Empty on legacy resolvers.

fields.name: data
fields.description: ENSIP-24 data(key) record as 0x-hex bytes (null if unset). From DataUpdated (record resolvers) and DataChanged (legacy).

fields.name: dataKeys
fields.description: All data(key) keys set on this resolver/name — a scalar list of keys, like `texts`; read values with `data(key:)`.

types.name: TransferData
types.description: Typed payload for `Transfer` events. Spans V1 BaseRegistrar ERC721 (`tokenId` numeric), V1 NameWrapper ERC1155 (`id` is the wrapped namehash, with `operator`/`value`), V2 registry transfers, ERC1155 `TransferBatch` summaries (`count`), and V1 Registry `NewOwner` rows (`parentNode`/`labelhash`/`subdomain`/`owner`).

fields.name: from
fields.description: Sender address.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Recipient address.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Token id: ERC721 tokenId as a decimal string, or wrapper/V2 token id (namehash for NameWrapper). Stringified to preserve u256 range.

fields.name: value
fields.description: ERC1155 transfer amount (always 1 for ENS NameWrapper).

fields.name: operator
fields.description: ERC1155 operator address (V1 NameWrapper / V2 only).

fields.name: count
fields.description: ERC1155 TransferBatch: number of tokens in the batch (per-token id/value are not stored).

fields.name: parentNode
fields.description: V1 Registry NewOwner rows: parent node namehash.

fields.name: labelhash
fields.description: V1 Registry NewOwner rows: labelhash of the subdomain label.

fields.name: subdomain
fields.description: V1 Registry NewOwner rows: namehash of the created/reassigned subdomain node.

fields.name: owner

types.name: DomainFilter
types.description: Filter criteria for querying domains

inputFields.name: tokenId
inputFields.description: Exact match on the current versioned ERC-1155 token id (ensv2 extension) — the labelhash with its low 32 bits replaced by the token's version counter, exactly what NFT platforms send. Accepts 0x-hex or decimal. Hashing is one-way, so this is the tokenId-to-name reverse path; combine with `registry` to scope to one registry contract.

inputFields.name: canonicalId
inputFields.description: Exact match on the version-masked canonical id (ensv2 extension; low 32 bits zeroed) — stable across token version bumps, for callers holding a possibly-stale token id. Accepts 0x-hex or decimal.

inputFields.name: registry
inputFields.description: Registry contract address filter (ensv2 extension) — the V2 registry that owns this name's label. Combine with tokenId/canonicalId to scope a marketplace tokenId lookup to one registry.

inputFields.name: name
inputFields.description: Exact name match (list filter). Unlike domain(id:), the domains/domainConnection list default-hides non-normalized, unreachable, and synthetic-root rows unless includeUnnormalized / includeUnreachable / isNormalized override.

inputFields.name: name_in
inputFields.description: Filter by name in list (up to 1000 names)

inputFields.name: name_not
inputFields.description: Negated exact-name match (subgraph parity).

inputFields.name: name_not_in
inputFields.description: Negated name-in-list (subgraph parity, up to 1000 names).

inputFields.name: name_contains
inputFields.description: Partial name match (contains)

inputFields.name: name_contains_nocase
inputFields.description: Case-insensitive partial name match

inputFields.name: name_not_contains
inputFields.description: Negated partial name match (subgraph parity).

inputFields.name: name_starts_with
inputFields.description: Name starts with prefix

inputFields.name: name_starts_with_nocase
inputFields.description: Case-insensitive prefix match (subgraph parity).

inputFields.name: name_ends_with
inputFields.description: Name ends with suffix

inputFields.name: name_ends_with_nocase
inputFields.description: Case-insensitive suffix match (subgraph parity).

inputFields.name: labelName
inputFields.description: Exact match on leftmost label (subgraph parity).

inputFields.name: labelName_not
inputFields.description: Negated exact-label match.

inputFields.name: labelName_in
inputFields.description: Label in list (up to 1000 labels).

inputFields.name: labelName_not_in
inputFields.description: Negated label-in-list (up to 1000 labels).

inputFields.name: labelName_contains
inputFields.description: Partial label match (contains).

inputFields.name: labelName_contains_nocase
inputFields.description: Case-insensitive partial label match.

inputFields.name: labelName_not_contains
inputFields.description: Negated partial label match.

inputFields.name: labelName_starts_with
inputFields.description: Label starts with prefix.

inputFields.name: labelName_starts_with_nocase
inputFields.description: Case-insensitive label-prefix match.

inputFields.name: labelName_ends_with
inputFields.description: Label ends with suffix.

inputFields.name: labelName_ends_with_nocase
inputFields.description: Case-insensitive label-suffix match.

inputFields.name: owner
inputFields.description: Filter by owner address

inputFields.name: owner_not
inputFields.description: Negated owner address match (subgraph parity).

inputFields.name: owner_in
inputFields.description: Filter by owner address in list

inputFields.name: owner_not_in
inputFields.description: Negated owner-in-list (subgraph parity).

inputFields.name: owner_
inputFields.description: Nested-relation filter on owner Account (subgraph parity). E.g. `{owner_: {id_in: [...]}}`.

inputFields.name: resolvedAddress
inputFields.description: Filter by resolved address

inputFields.name: resolver
inputFields.description: Filter by resolver contract address

inputFields.name: hasSubdomains
inputFields.description: Filter by whether domain has direct subdomains (one level only)

inputFields.name: subdomainCount_gt
inputFields.description: Filter by direct subdomain count greater than (one level only)

inputFields.name: subdomainCount_lt
inputFields.description: Filter by direct subdomain count less than (one level only)

inputFields.name: expiry_gt
inputFields.description: Filter by expiry date greater than (Unix timestamp)

inputFields.name: expiry_gte
inputFields.description: Filter by expiry date greater than or equal (Unix timestamp)

inputFields.name: expiry_lt
inputFields.description: Filter by expiry date less than (Unix timestamp)

inputFields.name: expiry_lte
inputFields.description: Filter by expiry date less than or equal (Unix timestamp)

inputFields.name: expiryDate_gt
inputFields.description: Subgraph-compatible alias for `expiry_gt`.

inputFields.name: expiryDate_gte
inputFields.description: Subgraph-compatible alias for `expiry_gte`.

inputFields.name: expiryDate_lt
inputFields.description: Subgraph-compatible alias for `expiry_lt`.

inputFields.name: expiryDate_lte
inputFields.description: Subgraph-compatible alias for `expiry_lte`.

inputFields.name: isMigrated
inputFields.description: Filter by migration status

inputFields.name: includeUnreachable
inputFields.description:
Include domains that are unreachable via canonical resolution
  (orphaned by subregistry repoints, label unregistration, or expired
  ancestors). Default false — set true for audit / debug queries.

inputFields.name: isNormalized
inputFields.description:
Filter by ENSIP-15 normalization status. When omitted, only normalized
  names are returned (non-normalized names like `Nick.eth` are hidden by
  default); set explicitly to `true`/`false` to filter, or pass
  `includeUnnormalized: true` to include both.

inputFields.name: includeUnnormalized
inputFields.description:
Include non-normalized domains (e.g. `Nick.eth`, `VITALIK`) that are
  hidden by default. Default false. Ignored when `isNormalized` is set.

inputFields.name: and
inputFields.description:
Boolean AND: every sub-filter must match. Each element is a full DomainFilter,
  nested recursively (subgraph parity). Combined with the other fields by AND.

inputFields.name: or
inputFields.description:
Boolean OR: any sub-filter matches. Each element is a full DomainFilter, nested
  recursively (subgraph parity). The OR group is AND-combined with sibling fields,
  so `{ owner: X, or: [{...A}, {...B}] }` means `owner=X AND (A OR B)`. Default
  visibility (reachable/normalized/non-root) is applied once to the whole result.

inputFields.name: timestamp_lt
inputFields.description: Filter by timestamp less than

inputFields.name: timestamp_lte
inputFields.description: Filter by timestamp less than or equal

inputFields.name: protocol
inputFields.description: Filter by protocol (v1 or v2)

inputFields.name: and
inputFields.description: Boolean AND: every sub-filter must match. Each element is a full EventFilter, nested recursively (subgraph parity).

types.name: OrderDirection
types.description: Order direction for sorting

types.name: DomainFinality
types.description: How settled a domain's current state is against chain finality (finality-tiered reads).

enumValues.name: FINALIZED
enumValues.description: The last change is at/below the finalized head; it will not reorg.

enumValues.name: SAFE
enumValues.description: The last change is at/below the safe head but above finalized.

enumValues.name: HEAD
enumValues.description: The last change is in the unsafe zone above the safe head; it may still reorg.

enumValues.name: VERIFIED
enumValues.description: The name's resolver.addr(node) resolves back to this address.

enumValues.name: MISMATCH
enumValues.description: The name resolves forward to a DIFFERENT address.

enumValues.name: INVALID_NAME
enumValues.description: The claimed name is not ENSIP-15 normalized (e.g. confusable/spoofed); never verified.

enumValues.name: NOT_FOUND
enumValues.description: No forward evidence exists: no resolver, or an empty/zero address record.

enumValues.name: UNVERIFIED
enumValues.description: The on-chain read could not be completed (revert or RPC error).
